overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation in the Board's roughly three-month delay in approving its November 25, 2014 minutes, and declined to review several other allegations in the complaint. Closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to approve its November 25, 2014 meeting minutes in a timely manner; approval came February 10, 2015.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that, although the Board's delay in approving its November 25, 2014 minutes was not desirable, it did not rise to the level of violating the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The complaint included several other allegations, which the AG declined to review because, even if true, they would not violate the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint also included several other allegations that, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.
